- Branch utilities: src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES (REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA): - ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase", "TryStatement", "CatchClause", "ForStatement", "ForOfStatement", "ForInStatement", "WhileStatement", "DoWhileStatement"]. - validateBranchTypes(context) (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE): - Reads context.options[0].branchTypes. - If branchTypes is an array, filters invalid values by checking membership in DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES. - If invalid types exist: - Returns `{ Program(node) { ... } }` that calls context.report once per invalid type with message: - `Value "${t}" should be equal to one of the allowed values: ${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.join(", ")}`. - This matches invalid configuration behavior described in the story. - If all are valid, returns the configured branchTypes; if no branchTypes, returns DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES. - gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node) (REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION): - For SwitchCase: - Uses sourceCode.lines and PRE_COMMENT_OFFSET = 2 to scan up to 2 lines above the case for lines starting with // or /*; aggregates them, supports the "switch with blank line and comments" pattern. - For other branches: - Uses sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node), maps to value, joins text. - Supports both line and block comments as required. - reportMissingStory / reportMissingReq (REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING): - Use context.report with messageId: "missingAnnotation" and data.missing set to "@story" or "@req". - Provide auto-fixes: - When first missing @story: inserts `// @story .story.md` above branch with correct indentation. - When @req is missing but @story present: inserts `// @req ` above branch. - getBranchAnnotationInfo and reportMissingAnnotations (REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, REQ-NESTED-HANDLING, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION): - getBranchAnnotationInfo: - Calls gatherBranchCommentText to get combined comment text. - Detects presence of @story and @req via regex. - Computes indent from the source line and insertPos via sourceCode.getIndexFromLoc. - reportMissingAnnotations: - Builds an `actions` array for story and req, each with a `missing` flag and handler. - Iterates with forEach and calls handlers only when missing is true. - Handles nested/complex control flow naturally since ESLint will invoke this per branch node.

traceability.notes: docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md describes an ESLint rule that enforces @story and @req annotations on significant code branches, with requirements for branch detection, comment association, annotation parsing, significance criteria, nested handling, configurable scope, performance, and documentation. The implementation in src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts and src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts fulfills these requirements: it supports all specified branch node types, correctly associates nearby comments (including special handling for SwitchCase and blank lines), parses @story/@req, and offers appropriate auto-fixes. validateBranchTypes provides configurable scope and clear configuration error reporting. The rule is wired into the plugin’s recommended and strict configs, satisfying integration requirements. User experience is covered with a clear, specific error message identifying the missing annotation, and tests verify both error reporting and autofix behavior across many realistic patterns, including nested/multiple branches. Documentation in docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md (plus the README reference) provides examples and configuration details matching the story. All related tests pass in the full Jest run, so this story’s acceptance criteria and technical requirements are met; the story is fully implemented.
